subject: Next steps: lock demo deep-dive and Sprint 0 (eval kickoff)
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@biolabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro / discovery — next steps

Hi Elaine — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we can lock the calendar and start the Sprint 0 for the evaluation:

• Recap (from our discovery): Biolabs is focused on automating pathology report summarization and embedding-based search across historical cases. Primary constraints: sub-200ms token latency for interactive QA, and SOC2 + regional data controls.
• Success criteria we agreed on: 1) Precision >= 90% for extractive QA on the 100-case prompt set; 2) end-to-end average generation latency < 300ms at 8 concurrent users; 3) no PII leakage in logs / traces; 4) clear quantification of per-token unit cost at trial scale.
• Proposed next meeting: a 60–75 minute demo / technical deep-dive + trial kickoff (Sprint 0) where we: align on trial scope, ownerships, security handoff, and ship a first prompt pack for evaluation. Agenda draft attached.

Proposed windows (Pacific time):
1) Thu Oct 22 — 10:00–11:15am PT
2) Fri Oct 23 — 09:00–10:15am PT
3) Mon Oct 26 — 01:00–02:15pm PT

If none of those work, please send two preferred 60–75 minute slots and we’ll accommodate. Items I’ll bring to the call: kickoff MPA (attached), trial plan template, prompt-pack template, and Ben (our solutions engineer) for the infra deep-dive.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (mutual action plan), prompt-pack-template.md (starter prompts + eval metrics)

Thank you — looking forward to locking this in.

Chloe Martin
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
chloe_martin@redwood.com | (415) 555-0127
Redwood Inference
